title: Island Skiff Adventure Tours
specs: If its cool a light jacket, wind breaker, sweat shirt or rain jacket is a good idea. ------------------- What to Bring: Please make sure your driver has a photo ID when you arrive.
Hilton Head Skiff Guided Boat Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.
All boat captains on the tour must be at least 18 years of age and have a valid drivers license.
Minimum age is 5 years old to ride with a valid operator with no maximum age, although you must be able to get on and off your boat unassisted.
includes: We provide ice water and dry storage on each guided boat tour of Hilton Head.
We provide a 6-pack cooler with water and you may bring snacks if you wish.
gap: Cancellations will not be accepted within 48 hour window prior to trip. If you need to cancel please call (843) 816-5976.
blurb: Join us for an unforgettable dolphin watch tour where you get to drive your own two-person CraigCat catamaran or skiff-style boat through the beautiful creeks and coastal waters around Hilton Head Island.
tags: Hilton Head Skiff Guided Boat Tour
extraNote: Customers may cancel anytime prior to the trip and get a full refund as longs as they give us 24 hour notice. · Island Skiff Adventure Tours can cancel the trip anytime for weather or any other reason with a full refund.

faq.a: Please arrive 20-30 minutes before your scheduled meet time to get fitted for your life vest and fill out the paperwork. You will be required to sign a Liability Waiver.

quotes.text: What a fun way to get out on the water. We had an incredible encounter with some dolphins I was sad we had to leave. We had to keep on time. I could have spent the entire day with the dolphins. It never gets old for me. He also took us to harbor town and took our photos in front of the lighthouse. I wish we were able to get more photos on the water too.

This tour was easily the best part of my trip to Hilton Head Island. We saw dolphins at a few different spots, and our tour guide, Duncan was knowledgable with the different kinds of wildlife that inhabit the area. The boats were awesome and it was super cool being just off the water for a unique experience. Thank you again from "Team Toronto"!

We thoroughly enjoyed the speed a little boats! Hold onto your hat and expect to get splashed. We saw dolphins, but after disembarking, there was a dolphin pat the pier providing a much better view! Would highly recommend this. We will repeat next visit. Look at Groupon for a deal or call ahead if you have a large group.

Excellent! The skiffs are fast and fun. Easy to maneuver. Ran high tide marsh channels in search of dolphins. Found several and up close. Swam up to us and under our boats. Really special. Included a mom and two babies. The guide was great. Knowledgeable and funny. He knew exactly where to take us. Highly recommended.
This was a wonderful experience! We saw loads of dolphins and waterfowl. It was fun and exciting! Nick was full of interesting facts about the island and surrounding area!
Jeff did a great job. You can really tell that he takes great pride in what he does. Saw lots of dolphins and driving the boat was a blast.
